role_sought: Member of the Bern cantonal government
detail: Ran unsuccessfully for the Bern cantonal government.

role_sought: Member of the National Council (canton Bern)
detail: First elected to the National Council for the SVP in the canton of Bern; took office 5 December 2011.

election: Swiss federal election 2015 (Council of States, canton Bern)
role_sought: Member of the Council of States (canton Bern)
detail: Ran unsuccessfully for the Council of States for the canton of Bern while serving as SVP national campaign manager for the 2015 federal election.

election: Swiss federal elections (National Council, canton Bern) 2015 and 2019
role_sought: Member of the National Council (canton Bern)
detail: Re-elected to the National Council, serving continuously until 31 December 2022, when he stepped down following his election to the Federal Council.
Nominated by the Bern SVP in November 2015 as a Federal Council candidate but withdrew his candidacy two weeks later.

role_sought: Member of the Federal Council (SVP seat, succeeding Ueli Maurer)
detail: Elected by the United Federal Assembly on 7 December 2022 in the first round to succeed retiring SVP Federal Councillor Ueli Maurer. Took office 1 January 2023.
